title: Staff shares
description: Staff shares calculated from sales, the business share, the payable balance and share payouts.
forbidden: You are not allowed to see staff shares.
empty_filtered_description: Change the filters and try again.
summary.staff_description: Period figures follow the selected branch; the remaining and payable balances cover every branch and day. A share is payable once its sale is fully paid.
summary.load_failed: The share summary could not be loaded.
summary.empty_description: Sale lines with a staff member show up here with their share.
lines.load_failed: The shares could not be loaded.
lines.empty_description: Each sale line with a staff member opens a share row here, following the staff member's rate.
payouts.load_failed: The share payouts could not be loaded.
payouts.empty_description: Pay a staff member their share from the summary tab.
payout_dialog.title: Pay share
payout_dialog.description: {{name}} · payable now {{amount}}. The payout is booked as a staff payment on the chosen account; no extra expense is entered.
fields.cash_account_none: There is no active cash or bank account in this currency.
reverse_dialog.title: Reverse share payout
reverse_dialog.description: The payout is not deleted: a reversal cancels it, the cash movement is reversed too and the amount returns to the payable balance.
rules.title: Share rates
rules.hint: A rate applies to sales from its start date on. A service's own rate wins over the default. Changing a rate does not change shares already calculated.
rules.dialog_description: Set the default rate of services or products, or the rate of one service.
rules.empty_description: Until a rate is set, this staff member's sales are booked with a zero share.
rules.fields.service_hint: Leave empty for the default rate of every service.
rules.fields.rate_hint: Of the sale line's net amount, between 0 and 100.
rules.fields.fixed_amount_hint: Never more than the sale amount.
rules.fields.valid_from_hint: Applies to sales from this date on.
mine.title: My shares
mine.description: Your share today and in the period, your payable balance and the payouts you received.
mine.no_staff_description: To see your shares, your account has to be linked to a staff record in this business.

validation.amount_positive: The amount must be more than zero.
validation.amount_too_large: The amount cannot exceed the balance payable now.
